title: My Alcoholic Escape from Reality
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In this autobiographical manga, artist Nagata Kabi drinks heavily to numb an unfulfilled life until severe stomach pain leads to a pancreatitis diagnosis and hospitalization. She recounts her hospital stay, her struggles with mental illness and medication, the effect of her autobiographical work on her mother, and her slow return to daily life and making manga.
life_message: Even amid lasting pain, small joys and honest self-reflection can help a person find a way back to life.
